amends.rule: this amendment replaces only the stage-2 *supervision construction* with teacher-solution SFT (registered as stage 2a). The teacher, student, optimiser, lr, schedule, seed, token accounting, general-capability bound, statistics and win condition of the S53 registration and the S54 amendment stand unchanged.

why_stage_2a_and_not_on_policy.trainer_capability: oracle/frontier/train.py implements two objectives for the full backbone arm: token-stream CE+reverse-KL and completion-masked cross-entropy (`--objective sft`). The S54 amendment's first-error corrective supervision needs a per-token suffix mask aligned from the shared prompt, which the trainer does not implement. The `--objective correction` path is attached to the `corrective` memory arm, not the full backbone, and is not a stage-2 substitute.

throughput_arithmetic.measured_on: 64 GSM8K-train prompts x K=2, batch 32 prompts, cap 1024, post-trained 2B, transformers 5.23.0, eager reference linear-attention kernels (`causal_conv1d` and `flash-linear-attention` are not installed in the pinned offline image)
throughput_arithmetic.projection: a 5M-token on-policy corpus (student rollouts plus a verified teacher continuation for every failed rollout) is at least 5,000,000 / 551 = 9,075 s = 2.52 h of teacher decode alone, before student rollout refresh, alignment and training. The stage-2a corpus of the same student/data budget is generated once and supervised directly, so the same GPU hours buy supervision instead of decode.
throughput_arithmetic.decision: teacher-solution SFT. The on-policy path stays registered as stage 2b for a session with the mask implemented and a faster kernel.

teacher_solutions.prompts: GSM8K-train and MATH-train items with an extractable train label (`frontier.rft.load_items`), selected by seeded stratified selection over (source, difficulty bucket, reasoning-length quartile)
teacher_solutions.prompt_protocol: the student's own tokenizer and chat template, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False, with the stage-1 instruction `Solve the problem step by step. Put the final answer in \boxed{}`; the training prompt and the scored prompt are the same string

selection_sizes.rationale: one verified solution per prompt; breadth of distinct prompts rather than K per prompt, because a single-prompt repeated solution teaches less than a new prompt and the corpus is small

teacher_solutions.verification: frontier.rft.verify against the train label; only verdict == correct is kept; ambiguous, unparseable, wrong and truncated (no EOS at the cap) completions are counted and contribute nothing
teacher_solutions.deduplication: exact generated-token-sequence SHA-256, global across both sources
teacher_solutions.supervision: prompt ids are masked to -100; the generated solution ids and the trailing EOS are supervised (completion-only loss, `--sft-examples`)

general_replay.source: HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-edu sample/10BT/013_00000.parquet (the pinned train-corpus source, revision 87f09149ef4734204d70ed1d046ddc9ca3f2b8f9)
general_replay.why: protects MMLU and MMLU-Pro; the source is not the held-out calibration text (wikitext-2 validation is never trained on)
general_replay.contamination: 5-word-shingle Jaccard against the GSM8K test and MATH-500 items; a replay document at or above the registered fail threshold is dropped and counted
general_replay.supervision: whole document supervised (empty prompt), truncated only at a document boundary

training.arm: full backbone, tied embedding frozen (498,113,344 trainable of 752,393,024 text-tower elements)
training.optimizer: corrected Adam8bit, block 256, stochastic rounding, int8 first moment (retained by the S55 real-gradient validation), bfloat16 second moment
training.epochs: at most 2 passes over the accepted corpus; the run stops at the held-out-solution-CE minimum
training.early_stop: held-out solution CE is evaluated on a stratified 2% hold-out of accepted examples at every saved checkpoint; the selected checkpoint is the minimum, and a second pass that raises held-out CE is not used
training.window: declared <= 6 h from the measured student tokens-per-second
training.unregistered_deviation_rule: any change from these knobs is a new registered amendment, recorded before the launch

accounting.processed_tokens: rows x seq_len actually consumed by the trainer
accounting.supervised_positions: solution + EOS positions that contribute a loss, reported separately from processed tokens
accounting.teacher_tokens: 2B decode tokens generated for the corpus, reported separately

statistics.maj16: reported on the same 50-problem subset as stage 1 for the headroom comparison, not as a win

win.statement: stage 2a wins iff (1) greedy beats post-trained 0.8B on BOTH GSM8K and MATH-500 with prompt-level paired 95% intervals above zero, AND (2) MMLU and MMLU-Pro each stay within the 1.0-point general-capability preservation bound
win.no_softening: a gain on one task, a family-mean tie, a maj@16-only gain, or a math gain that violates the retention bound is not the win

next_route_if_not_a_win: more teacher tokens at the same recipe (larger selection, K=2 on the short GSM8K prompts)
a second epoch only if the held-out CE curve shows it is still falling at the first-pass minimum
first-error corrective supervision on the student's own failed rollouts (stage 2b), which needs the mask the trainer does not yet implement
the validated higher lr (3e-05) only through the registered fixed-batch KL gate
does_not_change: teacher, student and their pinned revisions
the general-capability preservation bound and the win condition
the queue gate that the corrected bar receipt and the real-gradient validation precede any stage-2 launch
